prompt: Gray counts stars from the rooftop
title: Rooftop Star Count
irony: Gray plans to count every star, but she only loves them when she stops counting and dances.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Gray spreads soft blankets on the big-house roof under cold bright stars.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green hugs a star book and wants the exact total while Gray and Navy write counting rules.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black climbs the ladder fast, bumps the blanket, and the star count scatters.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The crew points up and chants together at the wide blinking sky.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Gray draws chalk boxes, Green names dippers, Navy shares pillows, and clouds hide stars.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Black dares a speedy recount, Green trips on blankets, and the chart flies off.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The crew keeps pointing and chanting under the peeking winking stars.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Gray holds her tangled list alone and sees counting steals the glow.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gray tears the list in two and chooses a slow twirl with Navy.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The crew dances in a sleepy ring while Gray sings the stars uncounted.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The crew lies back on blankets, sleepy-eyed, loving stars too many to hold.
